summary.name: Polymail
summary.one_liner: Polymail is an email client aimed at founders and operators, adding read tracking, follow-up reminders, scheduling, and light outreach sequences directly inside the inbox.
use_cases: setting reminders to follow up on email threads
letting people book meetings without back-and-forth
managing client and deal conversations without a CRM
consolidating multiple email inboxes in one place
summary.what_it_does: Polymail adds read tracking that shows who opened a message and how often. It lets users set reminders on any conversation so threads are not missed. An integrated calendar lets others book time based on shared availability. Sequences allow building simple structured outreach cadences from the inbox. Private notes on threads and a search that filters by unread, replied, starred, opened, reminders, attachments and contact name are also included.
notable: Read tracking and read receipts built into email
Follow-up reminders and snooze on any thread
Integrated calendar booking and outreach sequences
Shared private notes on threads for teams
caveats: AI-powered workflows are listed as coming soon, not yet available
Page does not state pricing or whether a free tier exists
Platform list is inferred from testimonials mentioning Mac and iPhone and the awesome-mac listing; the page does not give a full platform list
